[[File:Padmefull2Buns.jpg|thumb|[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] wore a purple-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Padmé Amidala's wardrobe/Legends#Senator's attire after the Battle of Coruscant|velvet cloak]] in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].]]
'''Velvet''' was a type of fabric.

==History==
Velvet was used to make [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] such as [[Gender/Legends|women's]] dresses.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref><ref name="DAG">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref> It was also used for [[Pillow/Legends|pillow cases]]<ref name="LOTFE">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref> and [[Couch/Legends|couches]].<ref name="Mercy Kill">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref> Padded velvet was also used to cover the palm of the serving hands at the end of the [[Manipulator arm/Legends|manipulator arms]] on [[Lovolan]]'s [[R-10 household droid]]. The velvet was slightly sticky to improve the adhesive traction when serving drinks.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
